name: cc-tuner
description: Tune Claude Code's own configuration. Ships claude-md-writer, task-flow, deep-review, verify-feature, a usage statusline, and a two-command spec-to-merge lifecycle: /cc-tuner:spec records DoR, tests, acceptance and DoD, then confirms and publishes a sliced plan; /cc-tuner:run works that plan, proves the behaviour against a running system, reviews the candidate SHA, and merges only with a verdict review and green CI on that exact commit. Start with /cc-tuner:setup.
